user.title: Search for a stop
user.description: Type part of a stop name (for example: {example}). LINZ AG LINIEN will return matching stops in and around Linz.

pick.title: Pick a stop
pick.description: Found these stops for "{query}". Pick the one you want to monitor.

settings.title: Configure {stop_name}
settings.description: How often to poll for departures and how many to surface.

data_description.scan_interval: Lower bound 30 s. The integration also enforces a 15 s domain-wide cooldown so concurrent stops never breach the floor.
data_description.limit: How many departures to fetch per refresh. The state attributes cap at 30.
data_description.show_stop_sequence: Adds each trip's remaining stops with live arrival times. Roughly triples the data fetched per refresh, so the departure list is shortened to 10 while this is on. Off by default.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Adjust polling cadence or departure limit. To change the stop, add a new integration entry instead.

data_description.show_stop_sequence: Adds each trip's remaining stops with live arrival times. Roughly triples the data fetched per refresh, so the departure list is shortened to 10 while this is on. Off by default.

error.no_results: No stops matched. Try a different spelling.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach LINZ AG LINIEN. Try again in a moment.

init.title: Options
init.description: Adjust polling cadence and optionally filter to specific lines.

data_description.lines: Pick the lines to keep. Leave empty to show every departure. The list fills once the stop has been fetched.
data_description.show_stop_sequence: Adds each trip's remaining stops with live arrival times. Roughly triples the data fetched per refresh, so the departure list is shortened to 10 while this is on. Off by default.

api_timeout.message: LINZ AG LINIEN API timed out after {seconds} s

api_http_error.message: LINZ AG LINIEN API returned HTTP {status}: {reason}

api_connection_error.message: Could not reach LINZ AG LINIEN ({error_type}): {error}

api_invalid_response.message: LINZ AG LINIEN returned an unexpected response: {error}

api_rate_limited.message: LINZ AG LINIEN rate limit hit. Back off and retry.

rate_limited.title: Linz Linien Austria rate limit hit
rate_limited.description: The upstream LINZ AG LINIEN API replied with a rate-limit error to polls for **{entry_title}**. Raise the scan interval or reduce the number of concurrent entries.
